You make a fair point, but I don't believe parties will ever wither and die unless we seriously change the voting system to stop encouraging the "two-party" system. A party-less system is basically the same as a 300 million party system, and the same forces that lead to the elimination of third and fourth parties will just as easily eliminate the fifth through the 299 millionth party.

We've seen in American history a lot of cases where a third party suddenly gains a lot of power in an election, but that doesn't lead to a three-party system, it leads to one of the three falling apart pretty quickly.
